name: St. Mary Parish, LA
findings: St. Mary Parish has 76 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Mary Parish has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Mary Parish list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
